Invoke a dark ritual, increasing your haste by 20% for 15 sec.

While active, attackers are afflicted with Cursed Blood. Can only occur once per sec.

At the end of the duration, your healing done is increased by 15% and you are healed for (15*1000/1.5)*(102+3.0 Points Per Level+SP*.2) over 15 sec.

Cursed Blood
Reduces healing received by 40% and dealing damage now causes you to take 71+1.2 Points Per Level+ShaP*.5+AP*.1 Shadow Damage. Lasts 5 sec.
